props.title: Where your pages live and how they are saved
props.lead: ShowAI stores projects, pages, components, and templates in a content library on your computer. Learn where files live, how saves protect concurrent edits, how to resolve conflicts, and how to back up and maintain the library.

Change the location: "Settings → General → Content Library → Select Content Library".

props.caption: Directory structure of a new content library (omitting lock files and temporary files)

nodes.name: .showai
nodes.detail: The entire directory is a content library. When backing up, migrating or handing over to another portal for use, the entire directory is used as the unit.

children.name: library.json
children.detail: Record the format version, storage method, and content library ID. The current format is 2 and the storage method is `sqlite `.

children.name: history
children.detail: The directory name follows the old version to maintain compatibility. It does not mean that the page history is saved here.

children.name: content.sqlite
children.detail: Saves the current content of all projects: page metadata and content nodes, resources such as images addressed by digest, precise dependencies of components and templates, concurrency tokens and operation receipts. Each save is done in a transaction.

children.name: workspace
children.summary: Readable files, generated by the database
children.detail: A JSON file that you and external tools can browse directly. Directly modifying the files here will not silently overwrite the official content: ShowAI will record the external modifications and wait for you to decide how to deal with them.

children.name: project.json
children.summary: Project name, folder and bound source directory

children.name: <Page ID>.json
children.summary: A complete document on one page
children.detail: For the format, see [Page File Format] (https://showai.renaissancemind.ai/doc/file-format).

children.name: conflicts
children.detail: `conflicts/<ID>/record.json `is generated when synchronization cannot be automatically merged, recording the original file, the source versions of both parties, and the retained copy page ID.

children.name: local
children.summary: Only belongs to this device, not synchronized
children.detail: Editor drafts, conflict snapshots, sync baselines, and recovery logs are all here. They are not uploaded to the server but are saved together with the complete archive.

children.name: sync
children.summary: Sync baselines, upload receipts, and interruption recovery drafts

children.name: receipts
children.summary: Operation receipt, used to identify repeated requests

content.text: Each save is a transaction: the content, current file pointer, concurrency token and operation receipt are written to the database together, and a readable file is generated after success. Even if the process is forcibly terminated midway, the recovery log will complete the readable files the next time it is opened.
Each page carries two version identifiers:

(resource token). When saving, you must bring the two values ​​obtained when reading. As long as the page has been modified by others during this period - even if it is changed back to its original state - the save will be rejected instead of quietly overwriting other people's modifications.
The content library only retains the current content of each page.

Data replaced by the new save is recycled when it is no longer referenced, so older versions of the page cannot be browsed or restored. If you want to retain the status at a certain point in time, please make a complete archive as follows, or export a copy of the page.

attrs.title: For Agents and Scripts: Save with version ID

content.text: Read it completely first and write down the returned
, and then use them to save or apply changes:

showai pages read PAGE --project PROJECT --json
showai pages apply PAGE --project PROJECT --input operations.json \
  --base-hash HASH --base-revision REVISION --json
Don't just resubmit the original full page content with a new hash: reread it first, compare it and then merge it consciously, or abandon this modification.
Reuse on request; submitting different modifications with the same ID will be rejected.

Your modifications in the editor first become local drafts, which are automatically saved during the input process; the draft remembers the basic version when the page is opened to identify which modifications are yours. The following is the complete process when the editor and Agent modify the same page at the same time. Click "Next" to view it step by step.

props.title: The same page was modified by both you and the Agent at the same time

steps.label: Open page (revision r1)
steps.detail: The editor reads the current content and remembers r1 as the base version of the draft.

steps.label: Edit, draft automatically saved
steps.detail: The draft is saved in `local/editor-drafts `and will not be lost even if the window is closed.

steps.label: Save changes based on r1
steps.detail: When the Agent reads it, it also gets r1, which it saves successfully first.

steps.label: Rejection: Version has changed
steps.detail: The editor displays "Save failed: Please handle conflicts." The draft is retained as is and autosave does not treat it as saved.

steps.label: Compare and merge drafts
steps.detail: Irrelevant modifications are automatically merged; overlapping areas are listed as "common basis", "my draft" and "official version", and you can choose or directly edit the merged page data.

steps.label: Save merged version (based on r2)
steps.detail: You can also choose to "discard changes and load the current file" or "keep the draft and return" to process it later.

content.text: Three conflicts, three ways to deal with them
Save conflict on same device: another window, agent, or CLI saved first
This save clearly failed and the draft is retained.
Save the merged result after comparing on the conflict interface, or discard the modifications and load the current version
External file modification: modified directly using an editor or script
The external version is first saved as a snapshot, and the release of related content is suspended; components and templates are first restored to editable drafts
Click "View External File Modifications" on the top bar and choose to import, merge or discard; after the component draft is repaired, save it as a new version
When automatic merging is not possible, the content of both parties will remain as a normal page, with the account and device indicated in the title.

# 列出、查看并处理外部文件修改
showai workspace conflicts --project PROJECT --json
showai workspace conflict CONFLICT_ID --json
showai workspace resolve CONFLICT_ID --resolution discard|import|merge --json

# 外部改动了组件或模板包：保留为可编辑草稿，修好后发布新版本
showai workspace recover-package CONFLICT_ID --project PROJECT --json

# 预览草稿与当前内容的合并；加上 --revision 当前版本 才会保存
showai workspace merge PAGE --project PROJECT --input draft.showai.json --base-revision BASE --json

Switch the scope to "Entire content library" in the sidebar search box, and you can search the page body, nested containers, component parameters, component and template descriptions and source code at the same time, and then filter by type: all content, page body, components, templates, source code or projects. The same applies to Chinese keywords.
The search index can be rebuilt at any time, and no component code is executed while the index is being built. Agent and script use the same index:
showai search --query "季度预算" --project PROJECT --kind page --json

A complete archive is a verified copy of the content library catalog: official content, readable files, native drafts, and recovery data are all there; search indexes and caches that can be rebuilt are not copied.

steps.title: Open "Content Library Space Management"
steps.body: Go to "Settings → General" and find "Complete Archive" in "Content Library Space Management".

steps.title: Fill in the archive storage location
steps.body: Enter the full path to a new folder that does not exist yet and cannot be located inside the current content library. Existing folders will not be overwritten.

steps.title: Save and auto-verify
steps.body: Click "Save Complete Archive". ShowAI first copies it to a temporary directory, records the SHA-256 digest of each file and writes `archive.json `, and then renames it to the folder you specify after verifying that it is correct.
steps.result: It prompts "The complete archive has been saved and verified" and displays the archive path.

steps.title: Restore when needed
steps.body: Verify the archive first, then copy it to a new location, pointing to the copy using Settings → General → Library → Select Library or `--home `.
steps.result: When the verification is passed,`verified: true `, content library ID and file number are returned.

content.text: An archive records the entire content library that preserves that moment. It is different from exporting: exporting only contains one page or website and is suitable for sharing; archiving is used to retrieve all projects after changing computers, reinstalling or misoperation.
View occupied space and organize it

"Settings → General → Content library space management" displays the occupation by categories: formal content, readable files, search and operation index, local drafts, external modification snapshots, recovery data, original content library, etc.; "Analyze project storage space" then sorts by project.
Enabled by default: After the workbench is idle for a period of time, the content will be repackaged without loss and no official content will be deleted. You can also click "Compress Now".

: First list the generated caches that can be safely deleted, and then click "Clean these files" after confirmation. Current content, original content library, drafts, and conflict snapshots are all protected.
: Used when the search results are obviously incorrect, and the content itself will not be affected.

attrs.title: Upgrading from a legacy content library

content.text: When opening the content library in the old format, "Upgrade Content Library" will appear in "Settings → General → Content Library". The upgrade first reads, converts and checks all project, page, component and template versions, and then activates them after confirming that they are correct; the original files are retained as recovery materials.

Old snapshots lack reliable modification time, author and order and are listed separately in the upgrade report. Please process the unsaved modifications of the current page before upgrading, and the local draft will be retained.
